items.title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron sued in US over memory price fixing
items.title_zh: 三星、SK海力士、美光在美遭集体诉讼，被指操控DRAM价格
items.summary: The three largest DRAM suppliers — Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, who together control nearly the entire global DRAM market — have been hit with a class-action antitrust suit in California federal court, alleging they restricted supply of traditional DRAM products while prices surged during the ongoing global memory shortage.

items.title: Apple struggles to get clearance for Chinese RAM, even for Chinese iPhones
items.title_zh: 苹果难以获批采购中国内存芯片，即便为中国版iPhone也不例外
items.summary: Apple is encountering resistance in its bid to buy DRAM from blacklisted Chinese chipmakers CXMT and YMTC, according to reports. The company reportedly proposed using the chips solely in Chinese-market iPhones, following yesterday's revelation of its lobbying effort with the Trump administration.

items.title: X Square Robot hits $2.8B valuation, backed by all four Chinese internet giants
items.title_zh: X Square Robot 达到28亿美元估值，背后聚集中国四大互联网巨头
items.summary: The embodied-AI company X Square Robot completed four successive funding rounds culminating in a Series C, reaching a $2.8 billion valuation and becoming the only physical-AI startup backed by all four of China's internet majors.

items.title: BYD plans to ship its self-driving chip Xuanji A3 in production models by 2027
items.title_zh: 比亚迪自研智驾芯片璇玑A3计划2027年首搭量产车型
items.summary: 比亚迪正计划明年在腾势品牌量产新车上首搭自研智驾芯片璇玑A3。该芯片采用4nm制程，单颗算力超过700 TOPS，三颗协同总算力超2100 TOPS，支持L3/L4自动驾驶，已开始量产。

items.title: Zhipingfang hits $2.8B valuation as Greater Bay Area's first embodied-AI unicorn
items.title_zh: 智平方达200亿元估值，成粤港澳大湾区首家具身智能独角兽
items.summary: Zhipingfang completed roughly ¥5 billion in new funding on the back of its brain-inspired NeuroVLA architecture, pushing its total valuation past ¥20 billion and making it the first embodied-AI unicorn in China's Greater Bay Area.

items.title: California governor Newsom signs statewide Anthropic Claude deal with 50% discount
items.title_zh: 加州州长纽森与Anthropic签约，全州半价普及Claude大模型
items.summary: 加州州长加文·纽森已与Anthropic达成合作，以优惠采购价在加州各级政府全面推广Claude系列大模型：州政府部门、自愿参与的县市采购该服务可享五折优惠，合作条款同时包含Anthropic免费培训和专属技术支持。

items.title: Rocket Lab acquires Iridium's satellite network for $8 billion to take on SpaceX
items.title_zh: Rocket Lab以80亿美元收购铱星卫星网络，挑战SpaceX
items.summary: Rocket Lab announced plans to acquire Iridium Communications for $8 billion, combining its launch services and spacecraft manufacturing with Iridium's satellite-based communications network to better compete with SpaceX.

items.title: Lawmakers want to ban AI companies from selling your health data
items.title_zh: 立法者希望禁止AI公司出售用户健康数据
items.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren and Rep. Mary Gay Scanlon plan to introduce the updated Health and Location Data Protection Act, which would ban the sale of Americans' health and location information to data brokers — including data revealed to AI chatbots such as ChatGPT or Claude.

items.title: Robot hand startup Proception settles Tesla trade-secret suit, raises $11M
items.title_zh: 机器人手初创公司Proception和解特斯拉商业秘密诉讼，并融资1100万美元
items.summary: Robotics startup Proception settled a trade-secret suit brought by Tesla and simultaneously announced an $11 million fundraise. The company is taking a unique approach to collecting training data to solve one of the hardest problems in robotics: dexterous hands.

items.title: Tesla starts FSD v14 'Lite' rollout to Hardware 3 vehicles
items.title_zh: 特斯拉开始向HW3车辆推送FSD v14精简版
items.summary: Tesla began rolling out FSD v14 'Lite' to roughly 4 million Hardware 3 vehicles that had been frozen on v12.6, according to AI chief Ashok Elluswamy; the build first ships to early-access drivers as firmware 2026.20.5.1.

items.title: Omen AI raises $31M to monitor data-center chip coolant and stop bacterial outbreaks
items.title_zh: Omen AI融资3100万美元，用于监控数据中心芯片冷却液并防止细菌爆发
items.summary: Omen AI raised a $31 million Series A for its AI-driven monitoring system that tracks chip coolant quality in data centers and detects bacterial outbreaks that can degrade cooling performance.

items.title: X Square Robot hits $2.8B valuation, backed by all four Chinese internet giants
items.title_zh: X Square Robot 达到28亿美元估值，背后聚集中国四大互联网巨头

items.title: ChenSi Tech lands new funding for digital phased-array chips, backed by ex-HiSilicon and ZTE team
items.title_zh: 宸思科技完成新一轮融资，加码数字相控阵芯片与模组迭代
items.summary: 广州宸思通讯科技有限公司完成新一轮融资，由厦门高新投独家投资。公司聚焦数字相控阵芯片及模组研发，具备芯片-模组-产品垂直整合能力，面向低空经济、卫星互联网、雷达等场景，核心技术源于海思、中兴团队的创业积累。

items.title: Moxy launches first AI companion robot with full-area flexible e-skin, no cameras needed
items.title_zh: Moxy摸喜发布首款AI陪伴机器人，搭载自研全域柔性电子皮肤
items.summary: 奥感微旗下品牌Moxy摸喜在深圳发布首款AI陪伴机器人，以无对话、无摄像头、纯触觉交互为核心特色，首次将离电型柔性触觉传感技术完整应用于消费级陪伴产品。

items.title: China launches world's first photonic-computing satellite enabling space-based AI
items.title_zh: 中国发射全球首颗光子计算卫星，用光代替电子实现太空AI计算
items.summary: Guangbenwei Technology and Dongfang Tianxuan launched the world's first space-based photonic computing satellite, using light instead of electrons to overcome radiation, heat dissipation, and power constraints for satellite AI workloads.

items.title: commaai/openpilot
items.title_zh: commaai/openpilot — 面向机器人与辅助驾驶的开源操作系统
items.summary: openpilot is an open-source operating system for robotics that currently upgrades the driver-assistance system on more than 300 supported cars.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.title_zh: xbtlin/ai-berkshire — AI时代的伯克希尔：基于多Agent的价值投资研究框架
items.summary: AI-era Berkshire: a value-investing research framework built for Claude Code and Codex, implementing the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu with multi-agent adversarial analysis.

items.title: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw
items.title_zh: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw — 基于AI Agent + MCP的自动化渗透测试框架
items.summary: VulnClaw is an AI Agent + MCP toolchain + penetration-skill orchestration framework that automates the full pipeline from information gathering through vulnerability discovery and exploitation to report generation using natural-language input.

items.title: cupy/cupy
items.title_zh: cupy/cupy — GPU 上的 NumPy 与 SciPy
items.summary: CuPy is an open-source array library for GPU-accelerated computing with Python, providing a NumPy/SciPy-compatible API for NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm platforms.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
items.title_zh: Qwen/Qwen3-4B — 通义千问3代4B参数模型
items.summary: Qwen3-4B is a 4B-parameter model in Alibaba's Qwen3 series, with over 15 million downloads, supporting text generation in a transformer architecture.

items.title: BAAI/bge-m3
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 北京智源多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BGE-M3 from Beijing Academy of AI is a multilingual embedding model built on XLM-RoBERTa with over 31 million downloads, widely used for retrieval and feature extraction tasks.

items.title: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5
items.title_zh: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 — Nomic AI文本嵌入模型v1.5
items.summary: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 is a sentence-transformers embedding model from Nomic AI, with nearly 18 million downloads, optimized for feature extraction using a BERT-based architecture.

items.title: The Signal-Coverage Matrix: Stratifying Type and Semantic Errors in Statement Autoformalization
items.title_zh: 信号覆盖矩阵：分层分析语句自动形式化中的类型与语义错误
items.summary: DeepSeek researchers propose a signal-coverage matrix crossing the Lean elaborator (pass/fail) with a semantic-equivalence judgment, revealing that LLM autoformalization's headline type-correctness gains conceal which errors each method actually resolves.

items.title: Which Nash Equilibrium? Solver-Dependent Selection on Zero-Sum Nash Polytopes
items.title_zh: 哪个纳什均衡？零和纳什多面体上的求解器依赖选择
items.summary: MiniMax researchers study how different game-theory solvers select different members of Nash equilibrium polytopes in two-player zero-sum games, questioning whether these solvers are truly interchangeable.

items.title: HORIZON: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
items.title_zh: HORIZON：将硬件设计视为代码仓库级演化的智能体框架
items.summary: HORIZON is a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution, compiling a Markdown harness into a project pack with domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate, and a git/runtime policy.

items.title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: PhysisForcing：面向机器人操作的物理强化世界模拟器
items.summary: PhysisForcing is a physics-reinforced world simulator that uses explicit physical constraints to prevent the physically implausible manipulations common in generic video-generation models, targeting more reliable embodied world simulation.
